name: Unstable Floor
disable: DC 20 Engineering-lore check, DC 20 Mining-lore check, or DC 23 Survival check to determine the exact extent of the unstable ground and to optionally cause it to collapse safely into area A2 below

items.name: Deeper into the Darkness
items.text:
Trigger A Small or larger creature walks onto the weak limestone

---
Effect The ground collapses, and the triggering creature falls 15 feet into area A2 below. The creature can try to grab-an-edge dc=23 to avoid falling, otherwise the fall inflicts 7 bludgeoning damage plus an additional 4d6+3 bludgeoning damage (DC 23 basic Reflex save save) from falling rubble.

text: An unstable section of limestone crumbles under the weight of anyone who steps on it.
